Name: Gunhawk (Hardwick)
Description: Note: There are three people known as Gunhawk; The first was an Atlas era cowboy named "Red Larabee" whom had his own series and first appeared in The Gunhawk Issue 12. The second, and more well known Gunhawk is Lee Barnett, whom made his first appearance in Western Gunfighters Issue 1.
